title: warden decision record
description: A ruling bound to a commit and rules_version: what was decided, why, what it costs if wrong, the alternatives weighed, and the scope it governs. Borrowed from the ephemeral 'Ruling:' ledger line and made durable so decisions compound.

head_sha.description: the commit the decision was made at (HEAD when recorded)

base_sha.description: the commit state the decision was made AGAINST — defaults to head_sha ('as of this commit'). It is NOT a diff base: a decision is a ruling, not a review of a range, and no reader should compute head_sha..base_sha from it.

decided.description: the ruling itself, in one line

why.description: the reasoning a later reader can agree or disagree with

cost_if_wrong.description: what it costs if this turns out to be the wrong call

alternatives.description: the options considered and not taken; at least one, because a decision with no alternative was not a decision

scope.description: what this ruling governs, and where it stops

pr.description: PR number/URL this decision belongs to

bead.description: tracker id the decision belongs to
